title: Portrait of Travis
content: I had breakfast yesterday withTravis Louie, who paints a menagerie of fantastical creatures and curious people.(Link to video on Facebook) I knew he wouldn't mind if I exaggerated him a little and made him into a slightly fictionalized character himself.With a gouache sketch like this, I start off with big brushes, visualizing of the head as a mass of clay. I'm looking for the forms beneath the features. Once that's all roughed in, I can drop in eyebrows and other details.------Travis Louiewebsite.
